description.value: This self-contained environmental suit is used by astronauts to maneuver and survive outside of a planet’s atmosphere. A tech level 2 suit is capable of an hour of operation in the vacuum of space with a flight speed of 2m in environments without gravity. Every tech level beyond 2 doubles this time and speed (2 hours at TL 3, 4 at TL 4 and 8 at TL 5). No tech level 1 space suits have been discovered. When a character in a space suit suffers piercing or slashing damage, the suit may be compromised. The wearer must succeed at a Reflex save with a DC equal to the damage suffered (maximum DC 20). If successful, the suit is not damaged. Otherwise it is compromised. When a suit is compromised roll the TD to determine how many minutes of operation the suit loses each minute until it is repaired. Each time a suit is compromised, roll a new TD and add it to the total minutes of operation leaking per minute.
